remarks: Nantucket-Shingle coastal-chic style home with exceptional amenities in Hoyt Farm. Nestled on a cul-de-sac within a sought after neighborhood, a custom-designed home embodies a captivating shingle style home. This meticulously updated residence offers an abundance of space and remarkable features for comfortable living and entertaining. Upon entering the double-height foyer, you are greeted by an immediate sense of spaciousness and elegant flow. The heart of the home lies within the state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen, breakfast room & great room, which seamlessly connect to the outdoor entertaining spaces. The home uniquely features 2 primary suites; 1 conveniently located on the 1st floor & the other on the 2nd floor. This configuration is ideal for an in-law or au pair suite, providing privacy and comfort for multi-generational living or guests. Additional living and entertainment spaces extend to the finished lower level, which boasts a wine cellar and an exercise room. This thoughtful design ensures that every need & desire for relaxation, recreation, and luxury is met within this magnificent home. Step into your own private oasis with a stunning saltwater pool & fire pit, perfect for entertaining or relaxing evenings under the stars. The beautifully manicured gardens surround the home creating a picturesque setting, while the screened-in porch offers a tranquil space to enjoy the beauty of nature element-free. Finished lower level includes gym, wine cellar & playroom.
